# Core Rules Requirements Quality Checklist: Shipment Registration and Dispatch Board

**Purpose**: Formal gate on the quality of the requirements for money and rates, security and access, and data, lifecycle, and audit, before they are turned into tasks
**Created**: 2026-09-30
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md) · supporting: [data-model.md](../data-model.md), [research.md](../research.md), [contracts/http-api.md](../contracts/http-api.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

**Focus**: money and rates · security and access · data, lifecycle, and audit
**Depth**: formal gate · **Reviewer and timing**: project owner, before `/speckit-tasks`

## Money and Rates — Completeness

- [x] CHK001 Is the way a carrier handoff gets its rate zone specified, given that its destination is a carrier and a town rather than a catalog neighborhood? [Gap, Spec §Edge Cases, §FR-006]
- [x] CHK002 Are lower and upper bounds for a fee (calculated or manual) defined, or is any positive amount explicitly acceptable? [Gap, Spec §FR-006, §FR-007]
- [x] CHK003 Is the confirmation required for a COD amount above COP 2.000.000 stated as a functional requirement and not only as an edge case? [Traceability, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [x] CHK004 Is the "marked for the owner's review" outcome specified end to end: where the owner sees it, and how a shipment stops being marked? [Gap, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [x] CHK005 Are requirements defined for correcting or withdrawing a rate card entry that was scheduled by mistake before it takes effect? [Gap, Spec §FR-028]
- [x] CHK006 Is the accepted input format for money (separators, currency symbol, decimals rejected) specified, in addition to its display format? [Gap, Spec §FR-012]

## Money and Rates — Clarity and Consistency

- [x] CHK007 Is it unambiguous what happens to an overridden fee when a later edit changes the rate zone or service level (kept, recalculated, or asked again)? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-007, §FR-008]
- [x] CHK008 Are FR-008 and User Story 3 scenario 1 consistent about which rate card instant is used when a fee is recalculated after an edit? [Consistency, Spec §FR-008, §US3]
- [x] CHK009 Is the granularity and time zone of a rate's "effective date" defined (calendar day in Bogotá versus an exact instant)? [Clarity, Spec §FR-028, §US6]
- [x] CHK010 Is it specified whether a merchant's express surcharge override may be zero, and how that differs from having no override? [Clarity, Spec §FR-006]
- [x] CHK011 Is the minimum acceptable content of a "reason" (override, errand fee, voiding) defined so that it can be validated objectively? [Clarity, Spec §FR-007, §FR-007a, §FR-015]
- [x] CHK012 Do the payment mode rules stay consistent when the fee changes after registration, for all three modes and not only "Flete al destinatario"? [Consistency, Spec §FR-009, §Edge Cases]
- [x] CHK013 Is the effect of changing a neighborhood's rate zone on already registered shipments stated explicitly? [Clarity, Spec §FR-008, §FR-026]

## Money and Rates — Acceptance Criteria

- [x] CHK014 Can SC-003 ("no shipment exists without a fee") be verified objectively for errands and for shipments with no rate available? [Measurability, Spec §SC-003, §FR-007a]
- [x] CHK015 Do acceptance scenarios exist for the express surcharge, including a merchant-specific surcharge? [Coverage, Gap, Spec §FR-006]
- [x] CHK016 Do acceptance scenarios cover a fee override that is later edited or removed? [Coverage, Gap, Spec §FR-007]

## Security and Access — Completeness

- [x] CHK017 Are password requirements (minimum length, rejected passwords) specified? [Gap, Spec §FR-030]
- [x] CHK018 Is the creation of the very first owner account specified as a requirement and not only as a seed step in the quickstart? [Gap, Spec §FR-032]
- [x] CHK019 Is it specified whether the system must always keep at least one active owner, including when an owner tries to deactivate or demote themself? [Gap, Spec §FR-032]
- [x] CHK020 Is the effect of a password reset on the user's open sessions defined? [Gap, Spec §FR-030, §FR-033a]
- [x] CHK021 Are requirements defined for what the recovery screen reveals when the email is not registered? [Gap, Spec §FR-030]
- [x] CHK022 Are audit requirements defined for changes that are not shipments: users and roles, merchants, couriers, neighborhoods, and the rate card? [Gap, Spec §FR-016, Constitution IV]
- [x] CHK023 Are personal data requirements stated in the spec: who may see recipient data, how long it is kept, and the Ley 1581 basis, rather than only in research? [Gap, Research §R15]
- [x] CHK024 Are requirements defined for changing a user's email or name after creation? [Gap, Spec §FR-032]

## Security and Access — Clarity and Consistency

- [x] CHK025 Is "temporarily" quantified for the account lock, and is the unlocking condition stated? [Clarity, Spec §FR-033]
- [x] CHK026 Is "valid for a limited time" quantified for the recovery link? [Clarity, Spec §US7]
- [x] CHK027 Do FR-026 (the dispatcher assigns a neighborhood's rate zone) and FR-028 (only the owner manages rate zones and rates) define a consistent boundary, given that the zone determines the fee? [Conflict, Spec §FR-026, §FR-028]
- [x] CHK028 Is the permission of each role stated for every capability in the feature, including export, read-only access to the rate card, and viewing fees? [Completeness, Spec §FR-025, §FR-031]
- [x] CHK029 Is "ends open sessions immediately" expressed in a way that can be measured? [Measurability, Spec §FR-032]
- [x] CHK030 Is the session rule for courier accounts explicitly deferred to feature 003, so that FR-033a is not read as covering them? [Clarity, Dependency, Spec §FR-033a, §Assumptions]
- [x] CHK031 Are requirements defined for the case where repeated failed attempts by a third party keep a legitimate user locked out? [Edge Case, Gap, Spec §FR-033]

## Data, Lifecycle, and Audit — Completeness

- [x] CHK032 Are the allowed lifecycle transitions stated in the spec itself, or is the reader sent to the data model for them? [Traceability, Spec §Key Entities, §FR-014]
- [x] CHK033 Is the set of editable fields defined, including whether merchant, shipment kind, and service date can change after registration? [Gap, Spec §FR-015]
- [x] CHK034 Are requirements defined for shipments that are open when their merchant, pickup point, courier, or neighborhood is deactivated? [Gap, Edge Case, Spec §FR-029]
- [x] CHK035 Is the time zone that defines "today" and the service date stated in the spec? [Gap, Spec §FR-002, §FR-021]
- [x] CHK036 Is the duplicate warning defined for shipments without a merchant reference? [Edge Case, Gap, Spec §FR-013]
- [x] CHK037 Is the dependency on feature 002 stated for voiding a shipment that is already assigned to a route? [Dependency, Gap, Spec §FR-015]

## Data, Lifecycle, and Audit — Clarity and Consistency

- [x] CHK038 Is "not delivered" in FR-022 defined as an exact set of statuses, stating whether voided, returned, and exception shipments are flagged? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-022]
- [x] CHK039 Do FR-021 and User Story 2 scenario 6 agree on whether shipments pending from previous days are included in today's counts? [Consistency, Spec §FR-021, §US2]
- [x] CHK040 Is the flag behavior defined for a pending shipment whose delivery window belongs to a past day? [Edge Case, Gap, Spec §FR-021, §FR-022]
- [x] CHK041 Is the scope of alias uniqueness unambiguous: may the same alias name both a merchant and a courier? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-027]
- [x] CHK042 Is it stated that a tracking number is permanent and never reused, including for voided shipments? [Clarity, Spec §FR-011]
- [x] CHK043 Is the matching key for recipient suggestions defined (name, phone, or both), and limited to the same merchant? [Clarity, Spec §FR-004]
- [x] CHK044 Is the outcome of a bulk confirmation defined when one confirmed row fails at creation time (all rows refused or only that one)? [Clarity, Spec §FR-020]
- [x] CHK045 Is "never lose form data" expressed as a verifiable requirement with its conditions (expired session, lost connection, conflict)? [Measurability, Spec §Assumptions, §Edge Cases]

## Traceability

- [x] CHK046 Does every edge case map to a functional requirement or acceptance scenario with an identifier? [Traceability, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [x] CHK047 Are the decisions recorded only in research (lock of 15 minutes, 60-minute recovery link, 10-year retention) reflected in the spec where they are user-visible behavior? [Traceability, Research §R5, §R15]

## Notes

- Mark items `[x]` only after review confirms the requirement-quality criterion is satisfied
- Leave items unchecked when they still require clarification, correction, or reviewer evaluation
- `/speckit-implement` reads checklist checkbox state as a gate and must not modify markers
- `checklists/requirements.md` has a separate built-in lifecycle maintained by `/speckit-specify` and `/speckit-clarify`
- Add comments or findings inline

## Review record

- **2026-09-30**: all 47 items evaluated by the assistant at the reviewer's explicit request
  and marked satisfied after revising the spec. The spec went from 36 to 43 functional
  requirements, gained identifiers for its 15 edge cases (EC-01–EC-15), a role permission
  table, and 12 acceptance scenarios; see spec §Clarifications, "Checklist review
  2026-09-30".
- Owner decision recorded: CHK027 (the dispatcher adds neighborhoods with an existing rate
  zone; only the owner changes the zone of an existing neighborhood).
- Defaults chosen by the assistant and open to the reviewer's change: fee confirmation above
  COP 100.000 (CHK002), reasons of 5–200 characters (CHK011), passwords of 8–128
  characters (CHK017), merchant and shipment kind not editable after registration (CHK033),
  duplicate warning by recipient phone when there is no reference (CHK036).
- Data model, contracts, research, and quickstart were updated to match.
- **2026-09-30, after `/speckit-analyze`**: the spec grew to 44 functional requirements
  (FR-042 idempotent creation; FR-024, FR-025, FR-026 extended). No checklist item changed
  state.
